{{Otheruses|Canister}}
A '''dye canister''' was an ammunition type for use with the [[CSPL-12 projectile launcher/Legends|CSPL-12]] [[Projectile launcher/Legends|projectile launcher]]. It was used to mark targets and had a ten-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] radius.
